entities.summary: Zhaire Jahi-ihme Smith is an American professional basketball player for the Oklahoma City Blue of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for Texas Tech before being drafted 16th overall by the Phoenix Suns and traded to the Philadelphia 76ers.
